extDescription.message: Practice singing with YouTube: change key, slow down without changing pitch, pick a channel or reduce vocals.

commandToggle.message: Start or stop processing audio in this YouTube tab

errorNotYoutube.message: Open a YouTube video tab first, then start processing.

errorNeedsGrant.message: This tab is not authorized for capture yet: press $KEY$ or click the extension icon once.

errorGeneric.message: The extension could not do that.

engineQualityHint.message: About 120 ms delay while shifting the key

engineFastHint.message: About 43 ms delay; lower quality for large shifts

noticeIdle.message: Open a YouTube video, then press “Start processing audio”.

noticeLive.message: Processing · audio keeps running after you close this popup.

noticeElsewhere.message: Another YouTube tab is using the effects. Starting here switches the source.

channelSubtitle.message: Pick a channel or reduce centered vocals

descLeft.message: Left channel to both ears; for sources with only the backing track on the left.

descRight.message: Right channel to both ears; for sources with only the backing track on the right.

descCenter.message: Reduces centered sound in the vocal range only; bass and cymbals stay, centered instruments in that range are reduced too.

channelCaveat.message: Note: Left only / Right only removes vocals only when vocals and backing were mixed to separate channels.

panelSwitchSubtitle.message: Appears below the YouTube video after you start processing here

layoutDetectingHint.message: Comparing the left and right channels of the source.

layoutStereoHint.message: Left and right differ: Left only / Right only and Reduce vocals will have an effect.

monoWarning.message: Mono detected: Left only / Right only makes no difference, and Reduce vocals makes everything much quieter.

panelElsewhere.message: Another tab is using the effects; press “Start” to switch them here.

panelIdle.message: Press “Start”$OR_SHORTCUT$ to begin; settings are kept and applied once started.
